name: com.promptimate.unity
description: Free, local text-to-animation for Unity. Imports .kimodo motions generated on your own GPU (NVIDIA Kimodo via kimodo.cpp, driven by the Promptimate MCP server) as Humanoid AnimationClips (root motion or in place, seamless loops, relaxed hand pose, IK goal curves for Timeline and Foot IK), and validates every clip automatically.
